The dffd template is a useful macro for hyperlinks to the [[Utilities#Dwarf Fortress File Depot|Dwarf Fortress File Depot]] ('''DFFD''' in shorthand). It can have two inputs: the file number, required, and a link name, optional.

<tt>{{tl|dffd|997}}</tt> &rarr; {{dffd|997}}<br/>
<tt>{{tl|dffd|997|Dwarf Fortress Map Compressor}}</tt> &rarr; {{dffd|997|Dwarf Fortress Map Compressor}}
<includeonly>[[Category:Inline formatting templates]]</includeonly>
<noinclude>[[Category:Template Documentation]]</noinclude>
